hero.sub: Bright, honest storytelling for the people you love most — based in Buffalo and Germany, traveling worldwide.

intro.quote: The best photographs feel like a memory you can hold — not a pose you can remember.

aboutPreview.headline: Hi, I'm Abby — so glad you're here.
aboutPreview.lead: I'm a wedding, couples, and family photographer with a deep love for the in-between moments — the laughter mid-toast, the quiet hand on a back, the look exchanged before anyone notices.
aboutPreview.body: I'm based in Buffalo, New York, and spend part of each year living in Germany. Whether your story unfolds in Western New York, the Bavarian countryside, or somewhere in between, I'd love to be the one to tell it.

services.label: The Experience
services.title: Two ways to work together.
services.description: Every session is shaped around the people in front of the camera. These are the moments I love capturing most.

tiles.title: Weddings & Elopements
tiles.description: From intimate elopements to full wedding-day celebrations — each collection is thoughtfully designed to document your day as it naturally unfolds.

tiles.title: Sessions
tiles.description: Couples, engagements, maternity, families, seniors, and milestones — relaxed, intentional portraits of the season you're in.

recentWork.label: Recent Work
recentWork.title: A selection of recent stories.
recentWork.description: Real couples, real families, real days — and the moments that ended up meaning the most.

loveLetter.label: A love letter
loveLetter.quote: “Abby captured our day perfectly. She made us feel like we were with a friend we’d known for years, cheering us on and making us feel completely comfortable. She paid attention to every detail and made sure to capture the specific photo styles I wanted. I couldn’t recommend her enough!”

contact.label: Inquiries
contact.title: Let's tell your story.
contact.sub: I'd love to hear what you're planning — wedding, engagement, family session, or something else entirely. Reach out and let's start a conversation.
